source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A condition generally considered unrelated to the nature of the birth experience itself","B":"Fairly little psychological impact at all, since physical recovery is considered the main concern","C":"A guaranteed, permanent psychological impairment with essentially no possibility of recovery over time","D":"Postpartum post-traumatic stress symptoms, warranting screening and appropriate psychological support"}}
source_row.rationale: Clients who experience a traumatic or emergency delivery may be at increased risk for postpartum post-traumatic stress symptoms, warranting screening and appropriate psychological support as part of comprehensive postpartum care.
source_row.source_detail: Psychological Impact of Traumatic Birth Experiences
source_row.source_name: Postpartum Support International — Birth Trauma and PTSD
